reason: The plugin is primarily an automation-oriented DeepSeek Harness extension that exposes a predefined Impeccable frontend-design skill set (design, redesign, auditing, polishing) through the platform’s skill system, rather than a standalone UI, data, or networking utility.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一个打包的 `impeccable` 前端设计技能，帮助用户按流程完成网页界面的设计、改版、审计与优化相关操作。
summaries.en: This plugin provides a bundled `impeccable` frontend-design skill for DeepSeek Harness, enabling users to run guided web UI design, redesign, audit, and polish workflows.

capabilities: Contributes a fixed `impeccable` skill resource package to DeepSeek Harness
Provides UI design/review workflow guidance for web interfaces through packaged markdown skill content
May run packaged Node-based helper scripts during workflow execution against the user project context

reasons.code: Repository README and description position this package as a bundled DeepSeek Harness skill provider for a frontend-design workflow, contributing `impeccable` to `ctx.skills`.
README documents install-time and load-time adaptation behavior (`adapt-skill.mjs`, skill frontmatter processing) and the need to run helper Node scripts for detection workflows.
package.json defines DSH bundle integration via `dsh.bundle.patch` and exposes plugin entrypoints used by the harness runtime.
